```js
const CoinbaseWebSocket = require('./CoinbaseWebSocket.js');

function getBrokerFeed(name, onTick) {
  switch (name.toLowerCase()) {

      return new PolygonWebSocket(onTick);
    case 'binance':
      return new BinanceWebSocket(onTick);
    case 'coinbase':
      return new CoinbaseWebSocket(onTick);
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported broker: ${name}`);
  }
}

module.exports = { getBrokerFeed };
```
